A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Patch-ioner study, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables and complete supplementary Sections 6-15. The additional page in v5 results from reference reflow.

before.justification: v3 reports original captioning evaluations, backbone comparisons and ablations in Tables 1-11, including supplementary experiments on decoder architectures and learned aggregation.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental results in Tables 1-11 and the supplementary material.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical patch encoding, regional aggregation, text-only decoding and modality-gap strategies. The supplementary learned-aggregation variant in Section 14 is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain the same trace, dense, region-set and image captioning coverage using COCO, Flickr30K, Visual Genome and their described derivatives. The COCO/ReLaion training experiments are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches throughout the main and supplementary tables. Table 2 retains the same zero-shot and region-supervised methods; Table 3 retains Llava1.5 One-Vision, Qwen2.5 VL and Qwen3 VL under both adaptation strategies.

E3.justification: The datasets' splits, sample counts, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets and testing procedures are identical, including the supplementary experiments.

E4.justification: The backbone, decoder-size, training-data, aggregation, resolution, memory-bank, modality-gap and learned-aggregation analyses are unchanged. The qualitative examples are also retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-11 and qualitative caption examples match. For example, Table 1 retains Talk2DINO CIDEr scores of 27.9, 31.9, 109.1 and 69.2 for trace, dense, region-set and image captioning, respectively.

T1.justification: The framework assumptions, mathematical formulations, memory projection and aggregation equations, including Equations 1-5, are identical. No mathematical reasoning or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion are identical, retaining the unified patch-centric framework, regional-captioning performance claims and introduction of trace captioning.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including fixed patch contextual scope, modality-gap hallucinations, the gap to fully supervised methods and the learned-aggregation generalization tradeoff.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training time, benchmark-generation instructions and supplementary training procedures match. The code and data access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 72 bibliography entries are unchanged after accounting for line breaks and pagination. No cited work or research positioning is added or removed.

P1.justification: v5 adds a funding acknowledgment before References, crediting FAIR, MUCES, ITSERR and SUN XR, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment reflows the references across columns and pages, leaving their final two lines on an otherwise empty PDF page 12 and shifting the appendix start to page 13. Figures 1-8 and Tables 1-11 are visually unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 adds funding disclosure but introduces a minor layout inconvenience by spilling two reference lines onto an additional page. The scientific text, evidence, limitations and reproducibility information are identical throughout the main paper and appendices, establishing no meaningful net change in overall quality.
